annotations.title: Plan a Style Sheet (design sheet) for a new pack

description: Requires an approved AlertForge account connection. OAuth-aware clients should start AlertForge's secure authorization flow and ask the user only to sign in and approve. Setup: https://alertforge.ai/ai-agents#agent-setup. The FIRST step for any new overlay pack -- prices the pack's shared Style Sheet (design sheet) WITHOUT spending any credits or creating anything. AlertForge's own web builder always asks the streamer these SAME 3 questions, in this order, before generating anything -- ask the USER these exact questions and pass their answers; never invent a theme yourself: (1) "What is your channel name? We use it where your logo or wordmark needs text. Letters, numbers, spaces, - and _ (max 20)." -> channelName. (2) "What should represent your channel? Describe the logo, mascot, character, or symbol you want." -> logoOrCharacterBrief. (3) "What should the overall style feel like? Describe the world, mood, visual style, and any preferred colours." -> themeAndColorsBrief. Returns a planId (valid 24 hours, single-use) plus the exact credit cost -- show that to the user, then call create_design_sheet with this planId. Scenes cannot be planned until the resulting Style Sheet has rendered (get_pack_status) AND been approved (approve_design_sheet).

channelName.description: The user's answer to "What is your channel name? We use it where your logo or wordmark needs text. Letters, numbers, spaces, - and _ (max 20).". Required.

detailLevel.description: Art style, a choice of look rather than of quality (the web builder's Flat, Illustrated and 3D). "clean" (Flat): bold, simple flat vector with a hand-made poster look. "detailed" (Illustrated): polished vector artwork with a richer scene and a finished character. "intricate" (3D): stylized 3D artwork; the pack's alerts follow that 3D look. Same quality and price for every style. Defaults to "detailed".

logoOrCharacterBrief.description: The user's answer to "What should represent your channel? Describe the logo, mascot, character, or symbol you want.". Required.

referenceImageUrl.description: An http(s) URL to a reference image (the user's own photo or logo) for the pack. Data URLs are not accepted here.

referenceRole.description: Only meaningful when referenceImageUrl is set. "character" turns the photo into the pack's character, fully redrawn in its art style; "use-as-is" reproduces a logo or character faithfully. Defaults to "character" when a reference image is given but this is omitted.

subjectMode.description: Whether the described subject becomes a generated character, a generated logo, or is inferred automatically from the brief. Defaults to auto -- mirrors the web builder's Auto/Character/Logo chips.

themeAndColorsBrief.description: The user's answer to "What should the overall style feel like? Describe the world, mood, visual style, and any preferred colours.". Required.
